versions.description_html:
Learn why organizations need a Microsoft AI Center of Excellence to govern, secure, and scale Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI initiatives safely.

Copilot pilots are spreading through M365, Power Platform, and Azure faster than most organizations can map them. One team uses Copilot to prepare meetings.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Stakes, the AI Problem Teams Can’t See Yet
  • What an AI Center of Excellence Actually Is
  • Why Organizations Need One Before AI Spreads Further
  • Pillar One, Governance: Decisions, Guardrails, and Proof
  • Pillar Two, Security: Protecting Data, Identity, and AI Actions
  • Pillar Three, Adoption: Turning AI Access Into Useful Habits
  • Build the First Version of Your CoE
  • Implementation Challenge and Next Step

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Build a Governed Microsoft 365 Copilot Learning Center
  • Reduce Escalations with Sentiment Routing in Dynamics 365
  • More AI & Copilot episodes on M365.FM
  • Best of AI & Copilot: the most-listened episodes
